findings.message: @stellar/stellar-sdk 16.4.0: decodes Protocol 30 ledgers but cannot handle W muxed-contract addresses (CAP-84)
findings.remediation: Upgrade to @stellar/stellar-sdk 17.3.0 or later. Stay on 16.4.x only if the app never parses, validates or displays contract addresses.

limitations: Static, offline analysis only: scanned code is never executed, and no network or RPC calls are made.
A finding is an indication to review, not proof of runtime breakage; no findings is not proof of Protocol 30 compatibility.
Stellar's November 3, 2026 (Testnet) and November 23, 2026 (Mainnet) dates are upgrade votes, not guaranteed activation dates.
Ignored directories, symlinks that are not followed, and files over the size limit are not inspected; see the skipped list.
